probe_1_no_name_at_all.change: snapshotEntry.name.clear() instead of the projection arena name (unmodified export path)

probe_2_sso_sized_names.change: FileName() returns a 4-5 char extension instead of 'entry_<n>.ext' (full unmodified export/serialize/parse path, same entry and directory count)
probe_2_sso_sized_names.note: isolates per-entry std::wstring heap allocation from copy/parse work

interpretation.conclusion: Roughly half of the measured first-generation total is spent materializing per-entry std::wstring names out of the projection's interned name arena (SnapshotDirectoryEntry::name is a std::wstring; every Projection-name lookup allocates once when the name exceeds MSVC's 16-byte small-string buffer, which 'entry_<n>.ext' does for n >= 5 digits).
